The Habsburg monarchy , [ i ] also known as the Habsburg Empire or Habsburg Realm [ j ] ( / ˈ h æ p s b ɜːr ɡ / ), and Danube Monarchy , [ 2 ] was the collection of empires, kingdoms, duchies, counties and other polities ( composite monarchy ) that were ruled by the House of Habsburg . From 1804 it was referred to as the Austrian Empire , and from 1867 as Austria-Hungary .
